apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: vuoro-schema-grants-v3, namespace: vuoro-shared, labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vuoro-schema-grants}}
spec:
  backoffLimit: 6
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
        - name: grants
          image: ghcr.io/bayleafwalker/vuoro-service@sha256:fe0ab4445a6a4b4ecc771376737e59811a0aaef91b1e52fc80af3cc08046607c
          command: [python, -c]
          args:
            - |
              import os, time, psycopg
              dsn=os.environ['ADMIN_DSN']
              for attempt in range(1, 61):
                try:
                  with psycopg.connect(dsn, autocommit=True) as c:
                    cur=c.cursor()
                    cur.execute('SELECT pg_advisory_lock(2026072201)')
                    roles=[('work','vuoro_work_migration','vuoro_work_runtime'),('execution','vuoro_execution_migration','vuoro_execution_runtime'),('knowledge','vuoro_knowledge_migration','vuoro_knowledge_runtime'),('audit','vuoro_audit_migration','vuoro_audit_runtime')]
                    if cur.execute("select count(*) from pg_roles where rolname like 'vuoro_%_runtime'").fetchone()[0] != 4: raise RuntimeError('roles pending')
                    for schema,migration,runtime in roles:
                      cur.execute(f'GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE vuoro TO {migration}')
                      cur.execute(f'CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {schema} AUTHORIZATION {migration}')
                      cur.execute(f'REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA {schema} FROM PUBLIC')
                      cur.execute(f'GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA {schema} TO {runtime}')
                      cur.execute(f'ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE {migration} IN SCHEMA {schema} GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO {runtime}')
                      cur.execute(f'ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE {migration} IN SCHEMA {schema} GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO {runtime}')
                    break
                except Exception as exc:
                  print(f'Vuoro schema grants attempt {attempt}/60 failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}', flush=True)
                  time.sleep(5)
              else: raise SystemExit('timed out waiting for Vuoro roles')
          env:
            - name: ADMIN_DSN
              valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-postgres-app, key: uri}}
